/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats
from gprofiler import GProfiler

counts = pd.read_csv('inputs/counts_raw_unfiltered.csv', index_col=0)
meta = pd.read_csv('inputs/sample_layout.csv')
meta['sample'] = meta['SampleID'].str.replace('-', '_', regex=False)
meta = meta.set_index('sample')
# Use all samples in the one-factor design; contrast CBD against vehicle DMSO.
counts_t = counts.T
counts_t.index = counts_t.index.astype(str)
counts_t = counts_t.loc[meta.index]
meta = meta.loc[counts_t.index, ['Group']].copy()
print('counts_t', counts_t.shape)
print(meta['Group'].value_counts().to_string())

dds = DeseqDataSet(counts=counts_t, metadata=meta, design='~ Group', ref_level=['Group','DMSO'], n_cpus=4, quiet=False)
dds.deseq2()
stat = DeseqStats(dds, contrast=['Group','CBD_IC50','DMSO'], alpha=0.05, n_cpus=4, quiet=False)
stat.summary()
res = stat.results_df.copy()
print(res.head())
print(res.columns)
# Filter valid tested genes
res_valid = res.dropna(subset=['padj','log2FoldChange'])
sig = res_valid[(res_valid['padj'] < 0.05) & (res_valid['log2FoldChange'].abs() > 0.5)]
up = sig[sig['log2FoldChange'] > 0].index.astype(str).tolist()
down = sig[sig['log2FoldChange'] < 0].index.astype(str).tolist()
universe = res_valid.index.astype(str).tolist()
print('valid_universe', len(universe), 'sig', len(sig), 'up', len(up), 'down', len(down))
print('top up', sig.sort_values('log2FoldChange', ascending=False).head(5)[['log2FoldChange','padj']].to_string())
print('top down', sig.sort_values('log2FoldChange').head(5)[['log2FoldChange','padj']].to_string())

gp = GProfiler(return_dataframe=True)
for name, genes in [('up', up), ('down', down)]:
    if not genes:
        print(name, 'no genes')
        continue
    enr = gp.profile(organism='hsapiens', query=genes, sources=['GO:BP'], user_threshold=0.05, background=universe, no_evidences=False)
    if enr is None or len(enr)==0:
        print(name, 'no enrichment')
        continue
    print('\\nENR', name, 'terms', len(enr))
    cols=['native','name','p_value','term_size','query_size','intersection_size']
    print(enr[cols].head(25).to_string(index=False))
    met = enr[enr['name'].str.contains('metabolic|metabolism|catabolic|biosynthetic|glycol|oxidative|respir|mitochond|lipid|fatty|amino acid|carbohydrate|nucleotide|protein', case=False, regex=True, na=False)]
    print('METLIKE', name, len(met))
    print(met[cols].head(30).to_string(index=False))
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats
from gprofiler import GProfiler
from scipy.stats import hypergeom
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests

counts=pd.read_csv('inputs/counts_raw_unfiltered.csv', index_col=0)
meta=pd.read_csv('inputs/sample_layout.csv')
meta['sample']=meta['SampleID'].str.replace('-', '_', regex=False)
meta=meta.set_index('sample')
meta=meta.loc[meta['Group'].isin(['DMSO','CBD_IC50']), ['Group']]
cts=counts.T.loc[meta.index]
dds=DeseqDataSet(counts=cts, metadata=meta, design='~ Group', n_cpus=4, quiet=True)
dds.deseq2()
st=DeseqStats(dds, contrast=['Group','CBD_IC50','DMSO'], alpha=0.05, n_cpus=4, quiet=True)
st.summary()
res=st.results_df.dropna(subset=['padj','log2FoldChange'])
sig=res[(res.padj<0.05)&(res.log2FoldChange.abs()>0.5)]
sets={'up':sig[sig.log2FoldChange>0].index.astype(str).tolist(), 'down':sig[sig.log2FoldChange<0].index.astype(str).tolist()}
universe=res.index.astype(str).tolist()
print('DE', len(res), len(sig), {k:len(v) for k,v in sets.items()})
gp=GProfiler(return_dataframe=True)
pattern='metabolic|metabolism|catabolic|biosynthetic|glycol|oxidative|respir|mitochond|lipid|fatty|amino acid|carbohydrate|nucleotide|protein'
for direction, genes in sets.items():
    enr=gp.profile(organism='hsapiens', query=genes, sources=['GO:BP'], user_threshold=1.0, background=universe)
    print('\\nDIR',direction,'rows',0 if enr is None else len(enr))
    if enr is None or len(enr)==0: continue
    # hypergeometric raw p from custom universe dimensions, BH across returned hit terms
    e=enr.copy()
    N=int(e['effective_domain_size'].iloc[0])
    e['raw_p_hypergeom']=hypergeom.sf(e['intersection_size'].astype(int)-1, N, e['term_size'].astype(int), e['query_size'].astype(int))
    e['bh']=multipletests(e['raw_p_hypergeom'].to_numpy(), method='fdr_bh')[1]
    sig_e=e[e['bh']<0.05].sort_values('bh')
    met=sig_e[sig_e['name'].str.contains(pattern, case=False, regex=True, na=False)]
    print('N',N,'query_size',e['query_size'].iloc[0],'sig_terms_BH',len(sig_e),'metlike_BH',len(met))
    print(sig_e[['native','name','raw_p_hypergeom','bh','term_size','query_size','intersection_size']].head(20).to_string(index=False))
    print('METLIKE')
    print(met[['native','name','raw_p_hypergeom','bh','term_size','query_size','intersection_size']].head(30).to_string(index=False))
PY"
